QuakeWorld Duel League is a division-based league, with regular seasons followed by playoffs. Old or new, master or rookie, the experience will fulfill your needs. Season games are quick, {{Abbr|GO3|Game of 3}}, to allow players with a tight schedule to participate. 

[[QuakeWorld Duel League Season 1|Season 1]] & [[QuakeWorld Duel League Season 2|2]] saw a lot of players battling across continents - Europe bolstering 3 divisions, also {{Flag/us}} North America had 2 divisions and {{Flag/au}} Australia had one division.

Season 3 is aiming to have 2-3 divisions and will have only North America section.
